findings: R1/S3: anvil/config.py adds station_budget_settings, pipeline_partitions and validate_station_budgets. The worst case is the named partitions plus the default for each unnamed model station; an over-cap set raises a ValueError naming the pipeline and its excess. anvil.yaml efficiency.station_budgets ships the 14-entry table exactly as the spec lists it, summing to 15000000, with max_run_tokens, require_usage and the top level station_budgets key unchanged.

R2/S2/S7: runner.precall runs before first and loopback dispatches and reads the per-attempt usage via telemetry.station_consumption/precall_decision. A refusal appends a step with executor None, records station, partition, consumed and refused_at, and ends through the wo-gh-41 exit path (exit_status budget_exceeded, termination_reason naming the station and its efficiency.station_budgets partition). Unmeasured usage is refused under require_usage and recorded as proceeded_unmeasured otherwise. The in-session correction refusal is enforced in tools/claude_station.py (CORRECTION_REFUSED); per the builder report, no runner-level test covers it, only the loopback path. Non-blocking, because R6b asks for either correction or loopback.

R3/S1: tools/claude_station.py receives ANVIL_STATION_BUDGET_TOKENS (partition minus measured spend) and ANVIL_STATION_PARTITION. It kills the session's process group once streamed usage reaches the ceiling and records status budget_exceeded with partial usage. executor.py exposes the record as result['budget_exceeded'] without touching the timeout keys. Non-blocking: the ceiling has only been exercised against a stand-in CLI, and when no usage is streamed it falls back to the pre-call check and the run cap without recording that the ceiling was unmeasured (both disclosed in the builder report).

R4/S4/S5/S8/S9: completeness_gaps runs only when completeness_active (efficiency partitions configured), matching the owner ruling of 2026-11-22 now carried in spec R4 and S4/S5/S8. It checks that the builder report exists and is non-empty, that the test-writer test files are present, that the attempt delta is non-empty, that the gate verdict is pass, and that no earlier station is failed without its artifact. It runs no command and repeats no literal validation. A failure sets gate_failed, so zero reviewers are dispatched and the gaps return through the existing loopback path bounded by max_loopbacks. Records land in the report's own completeness field set. The checks gate in gates.py is untouched.

R5/S6: cost_stations_view adds cost.stations with partition, consumed and amount. Stations are priced only when every measured call has a recorded price, and are labelled 'priced from the recorded price table; an estimate, not an invoice'. Unpriced stations show tokens only and are labelled unmeasured in money.

R6/R7/R8/S10/S11: there is one new test file, tests/test_station_budgets_completeness.py, and no existing test, pipeline file or anvil.json changed. The full suite run here gives 'Ran 802 tests ... OK (skipped=6)', matching the builder report. docs/EXECUTION.md names both budget keys and states the difference. CHANGELOG.md has a wo-gh-42 entry, and exactly one new decision record exists (0014). The builder report carries the four literals, the verified base ref, the partition table with sum 15000000, the test count and the new test file name. No em or en dash appears in the changed source, docs or tests. The status/ and work_orders/ paths in the diff are line bookkeeping written by the run commit, not builder edits; the S11 test exempts them explicitly.
